Name: Forager's Nooks and Crannies and Stardew Valley Expanded Compatibility Patch
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/33517/33517-1749854442-1419077452.png[/img][/center]
A super simple compatibility patch for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23468]Forager's Nooks and Crannies[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. Moves one map patch, one warp and two warp destinations 20 squares to the right in the Secret Woods when SVE is installed.

This mod was created and released with Wildflourmods' permission, however, and [b]I cannot stress this enough[/b], do [b][u]not[/u][/b] bug Wildflourmods if you run into issues with it. You shouldn't run into any issues, but if you do, ask in the comments here or raise a bug report.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/33517/33517-1749854450-789182973.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] (and all of its prerequisites)
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23468]Forager's Nooks and Crannies[/url] (and all of its prerequisites)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url]﻿
[/list]
[u][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/33517/33517-1749854457-128975496.png[/img][/center][/u]
Installation is really straightforward. If you manually install your mods, just replace [i]"[CP] Forager's Nooks and Crannies\data\Location\Mushroom_Forest.json" [/i]with the one in the Zip file. If you install your mods via mod manager, install this mod as usual and make sure it loads after the original mod. This mod does absolutely nothing without the original mod installed.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/33517/33517-1749854464-2131402090.png[/img][/center]
A little housekeeping: This version was made for [b]v2.2.1 of Nooks and Crannies[/b] and [b]v1.15.10 of SVE[/b]. If a future update is released, this edit will probably still function just fine (though if you installed manually you'll need to reinstall it when FN&C updates). I will update this page once I've confirmed compatibility, as if there are changes to the base Mushroom_Forest.json (prior to v2.2: mysticforest.json), they will not be replicated in this patch. Likewise if SVE suddenly makes a major change to the Secret Woods in a future version, this mod will need an update.
